text: Good evening. I'm looking after my grandson tonight while his mum's on a night shift. He's 5 months old. He's come out in chickenpox, spots on his tummy and back, and they're itching him, he keeps rubbing at them. Temperature is 38.5. Apart from that he seems himself, feeding and smiling at me. Plenty of wet nappies, changed two in the last couple of hours. I might be fussing over nothing but he's very little and I didn't want to just guess.
